TestOverloadFieldsCarryOptions gained only the reservation and binding setup an INIT-REBOOT now needs (segment.initReboot is silent for a client with no record); its assertions that file is read under 52=1/3 and sname under 2/3 are unchanged, and TestOverloadInterpretationOrder and TestOverloadAbsentFieldsIgnored are untouched. The {partial} scope (Tested 'The file field MUST be interpreted next', Gap 'followed by the sname field', server role only through options.go::findOption; the client meets neither clause through dhcp_v4_exchange_linux.go::acquire) is unchanged, and records on findOption are current. Partial stands. Prior judgement: Rejudged 2026-10-30 (independent auditor) after the row gained a {partial} scope. RFC 2131 Section 4.1: "The 'file' field MUST be interpreted next (if the 'option overload' option indicates that the 'file' field contains DHCP options), followed by the 'sname' field." Tested: The 'file' field MUST be interpreted next, proven for the server role only: findOption reads file under 52=1/3 then sname under 2/3; positives TestOverloadFieldsCarryOptions and TestOverloadInterpretationOrder (file copy wins over sname under 52=3), negatives TestOverloadAbsentFieldsIgnored (no 52, 52=1 leaves sname, 52=2 leaves file unread), revert records on every cover. Gap: followed by the 'sname' field, and per the reason the client meets neither clause: the split is by role, not clause, a limit of the selector model owned by journal row field-carries-two-meanings. Producer internal/plugins/iface/dhcp/dhcp_v4_exchange_linux.go::acquire passes each reply to vendored nclient4, whose dhcpv4 FromBytes never consults option 52. partial is the only verdict the gate allows that is true: enforced is refused on a partial row, unimplemented needs a {gap} that forbids the server tags, and weak/wrong would misdescribe tests that discriminate.
